description: 100-clip YouTube distribution-shift evaluation set: clip list and labels were frozen (hashed) before any clip was scored. Labels follow the provenance of the face shown, verified per clip from contact sheets, full frames, video descriptions and transcripts. Videos are not redistributed; regenerate the clips with extract_clips.py.
selection_rule: (1) every clip of the earlier released 37-clip set is kept with its label; (2) every verified fake-provenance clip is kept, up to 50, taking source videos in the order listed in clip_provenance.json and clips in sequence order; (3) real clips fill to 100 from BBC News videos in channel-listing order, clips in sequence order. The rule was fixed before scoring and never consulted a score.
